race.comment: PIKLEMEGRANMOTHER (10) returned last time with a solid second at Mt Gambier over 1300m. Finds a tougher race but she has the ability to test this field. SWIFT STATEMENT (6) finished fifth when resuming at Geelong two runs back then improved last start but found a couple better over 1225m at Geelong, beaten 2.75 lengths. Faces an easier assignment so he is perfectly placed to score. PHILMARMONIC (4) ran a couple of nice races in the debut prep and has been prominent in a couple of trials this time in so, so expecting him to in the firing line. SHUJINKO (5) raced on the speed from the outset last start and finished third over 1200m at Murtoa. Draws well here and gets Yendall, so he's worth consideration.
